name: Breezeline (Cogeco; formerly Atlantic Broadband)
notes: Researched from public help.breezeline.com articles, the My Account interstitial page and the breezeline.com home page only (no sign-in, no forms). My Account registration asks for the account number from the bill plus the service address or phone number, then has the customer create a breezeline.net email address and password, which is the sign-in for My Account, email and streaming TV, so the identifier is email. The account page offers 'Want To Pay Without Signing In?', My Account Sign In, Recover Username, Reset Password and Create Account. AutoPay is free, by credit card, debit card or bank account (EFT), withdrawn on the statement due date; managed online or in the My Breezeline app. EcoSave is Breezeline's electronic billing; current offers include a $10/month discount for EcoSave plus AutoPay from an ACH checking or savings account. Payment arrangement: Account Summary > delinquent balance > choose a new pay date > Submit. Western Union walk-in payments carry a $1.50 fee. The cancellation article covers what happens after cancelling (no early cancellation fee, charges through the billing cycle, 30 days to return equipment, final bill within 30 days) but offers no online cancel flow; customer service is 888.536.9600, so cancel_service is unsupported online (inferred). Late fee amounts and plan prices are not on the pages used and are left out.

cancel_service.note: Breezeline's help center describes no online cancel option; call customer service at 888.536.9600. There is no early cancellation fee, and rental equipment must be returned within 30 days.

help.title: Ways to pay your Breezeline bill
paragraphs: View and pay your bill in Breezeline's free My Account. To register, enter the account number from your bill and your service address or phone number, then create a breezeline.net email address and password. The same email and password work for Breezeline email, streaming TV and the My Breezeline app, where you can pay, manage AutoPay and paperless billing, and troubleshoot your modem.

You can also pay without signing in, or pay cash at Western Union with your 16-digit account number and the amount; Western Union charges a $1.50 fee per payment. New payments can take 24 hours to show in My Account.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: Breezeline's AutoPay is free. On each statement due date the payment is taken from the checking account, savings account, credit card or debit card you choose. Enroll from Pay My Bill on breezeline.com or in the My Breezeline app, which needs a breezeline.net email address.

help.title: EcoSave and AutoPay discount
paragraphs: EcoSave is Breezeline's electronic billing. Current offers include a total discount of $10 a month when you enroll in both EcoSave and AutoPay using an ACH checking or savings account. Offers are limited and can change, so check your own plan terms.

help.title: Set up a payment arrangement
paragraphs: If you missed a payment, sign in to your Breezeline online account, open the Account Summary tab and select the link in the delinquent balance section. Choose a new pay date and click Submit.
steps: Sign in and open Account Summary.

help.title: What to know about cancelling Breezeline
paragraphs: Cancelling ends access to the cancelled services right away: live and recorded TV, on-demand and purchased titles, Internet and your Breezeline email, or home phone and voicemail. Keeping only mobile service ends promotions tied to the other services.

Breezeline does not charge early cancellation fees. Cancelling mid-cycle still bills the rest of that month, or you can cancel at the end of the cycle. Return rental equipment within 30 days; the equipment charge is waived once it arrives. A final bill comes within 30 days and AutoPay pays it if you are enrolled.
The help center does not describe an online way to cancel; contact customer service at 888.536.9600, the number Breezeline lists for account help and for restarting service.
